saltaunty.description: A relaxed, warm Thai aunty in her fifties from a quiet mountain village in northern Thailand. Calm, soft, unhurried and smiling, a gentle twinkle of humor, never loud or rushed, like chatting kindly over a cup of tea. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent.

kwai.description: A big, easygoing Thai uncle in his sixties with a deep, mellow, relaxed voice and a soft chuckle. Calm and unhurried, warm and good-humored, never shouting, like a gentle cook chatting in his kitchen. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent.

kai.description: A sweet, bright Thai auntie in her forties who sells salted eggs at a village market. A light, pleasant voice, cheerful but relaxed and unhurried, softly amused, never shrill or loud. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent, like a friendly character in a gentle animated film.

nak.description: A sweet old Thai grandmother in her eighties with a soft, slow, quiet voice and a tiny giggle. Calm, cozy and tender, never loud, like telling a bedtime story. Calls everyone dear. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent.
